title: Genesis Platform - Comprehensive Refactoring for Simplification
objective: Refactor all components and stores to remove complexity, eliminate arbitrary pixel values, enforce consistent design patterns, and improve maintainability
principles: Follow Tailwind CSS best practices (gap-* over margin, standard spacing scale)
Component composition over monolithic components (>200 lines split required)
No arbitrary pixel values (use Tailwind scale or CSS variables)

user_stories.title: Eliminate Arbitrary Pixel Values in Layouts
user_stories.description: Replace all hardcoded pixel values with standard Tailwind spacing scale or CSS variables
acceptance_criteria: No w-[280px], h-[80px], min-w-[320px] patterns remain
All widths use Tailwind scale (w-80, w-96, etc.)
All heights use Tailwind scale (h-20, h-24, etc.)
Responsive sizing preferred over fixed values

user_stories.title: Break Down Monolithic Search Component
user_stories.description: Split search-bar.tsx (301 lines) into smaller, focused components following ui/logic pattern
acceptance_criteria: SearchInput component handles input field only

user_stories.title: Split Large Pin Form Component
user_stories.description: Break down pin-form-fields.tsx (271 lines) into modular, reusable field components
acceptance_criteria: Each form field in separate component
Components use shared field wrapper pattern
Validation logic consistent across all fields

user_stories.title: Refactor Map Canvas Component
user_stories.description: Simplify map-canvas.tsx (231 lines) by extracting logic into hooks and sub-components
acceptance_criteria: Map initialization logic in custom hook

user_stories.title: Simplify Image Upload Zone
user_stories.description: Extract upload logic from image-upload-zone.tsx (228 lines) into custom hooks

user_stories.title: Eliminate Margin Usage Across Codebase
user_stories.description: Replace all margin classes (mt-*, mb-*, ml-*, mr-*) with gap-* utilities in parent containers
acceptance_criteria: No margin classes used for layout spacing
All spacing uses gap-* in flex/grid containers
Padding only used for internal component spacing

user_stories.title: Standardize Design Tokens
user_stories.description: Create consistent patterns for shadows, borders, and border radius across all components
acceptance_criteria: Border patterns consistent (border for secondary, border-2 for primary)
Border radius follows design system (sm for containers, md for cards)

user_stories.title: Refactor Search Store Complexity
user_stories.description: Simplify use-search-store.ts by eliminating redundant state reset logic

user_stories.title: Add Barrel Exports to All Feature Directories
user_stories.description: Create index.ts files in all component directories for proper tree-shaking

user_stories.title: Standardize Color Theming Approach
user_stories.description: Consolidate color usage to use CSS variables consistently instead of mixed approaches
acceptance_criteria: All theme colors use CSS variables
Direct Tailwind color classes removed where appropriate

definition_of_done: All user stories completed and verified
No arbitrary pixel values remain in codebase
No margin classes used for layout
Barrel exports in all feature directories

testing_strategy.unit_tests: Run existing test suite after each refactoring
testing_strategy.type_check: npm run typecheck after each user story
testing_strategy.lint_check: npm run lint after each user story
testing_strategy.manual_testing: Verify UI renders correctly in browser

rollback_plan: Git commits after each user story for easy rollback
